https://gamejobs.co/Concepteur-Audio-S%C.description: (English version to follow) CONCEPTEUR AUDIO SENIOR Objectif du poste : En tant que concepteur audio senior chez Side Montréal , vos responsabilités seront de créer, développer, produire et intégrer l'environnement sonore des jeux vidéo et d'autres médias visuels, et peuvent inclure la direction de projets et le mentorat des membres de l'équipe. Vous serez à la pointe du son et démontrerez votre passion pour les jeux vidéo, ce qui vous permettra de construire des paysages sonores captivants, offrant aux joueurs et aux spectateurs une expérience immersive. Vous jouerez un rôle clé dans la concrétisation de la vision créative, en travaillant en collaboration avec le personnel audio et l'équipe de conception du jeu. Fonctions et principales responsabilités: Concevoir et éditer des ressources sonores de qualité supérieure pour les jeux vidéo, les bandes-annonces et autres médias visuels, dans le respect du style et de la direction créative du projet. Concevoir des systèmes, grâce à une compréhension approfondie des middlewares et des moteurs de jeux, permettant des hiérarchies de mixage dynamiques et des systèmes audio dans des environnements stéréo et surround, en collaboration avec les équipes de conception de jeux. Diriger des projets en planification, organiser du contenu lié à la conception sonore, travailler en étroite collaboration avec le directeur de création et les gestionnaires de projets. Intégration d'assets sonores dans des middlewares audio (Wwise, FMOD) et des moteurs de jeux (Unreal, Unity, moteurs de jeux personnalisés). Synchronisation et mixage audio sur des supports linéaires. Tester, trouver et corriger les bogues liés à l'audio. Comprendre les scripts de base en ce qui concerne l'audio du jeu et l'amélioration du flux de travail. Travailler en collaboration, assister aux réunions avec l'équipe et les partenaires externes. Contribuer à la documentation, au suivi des projets et aux procédures. Responsabilités spécifiques: Fournir du mentorat et de l'encadrement aux membres de l'équipe. Offrez une rétroaction régulière et soutenez le développement professionnel en surveillant et en évaluant le rendement. Soutien à la prise de décisions éclairées qui ont un impact sur les opérations et la performance globale au sein de l'équipe. Identifiez les opportunités d'amélioration des processus. Aider à l'intégration des nouveaux membres de l'équipe et s'assurer qu'ils s'intègrent bien dans l'entreprise. Établir et maintenir des relations solides au sein de l'entreprise. Autre: Adhérer aux procédures de sécurité, de confidentialité et de santé et sécurité de l'entreprise et s'assurer de la conformité de l'équipe. Adhérer aux procédures informatiques et RH de l'entreprise et s'assurer de la conformité de l'équipe. Comprendre le comportement éthique et les pratiques commerciales, et s'assurer que son propre comportement et celui des autres sont conformes à ces normes et alignés avec les valeurs de l'organisation. Requirements Connaissances, expérience et compétences: Expérience substantielle dans la conception sonore de jeux ayant occupé des postes clés pour des projets majeurs qui ont été livrés. Connaissances avancées en création sonore et grande maîtrise de l'utilisation d'un DAW (Reaper ou Pro Tools), en synchronisation avec du matériel visuel. Capable de démontrer une bonne compréhension du pipeline audio en travaillant avec un middleware et capable d'exécuter des tâches d'intégration avancées dans au moins un moteur de jeu (UE5 de préférence). Maîtrise de l'utilisation de tableurs et d'outils de collaboration, tels que Confluence, Jira et Trello. Maîtrise de l'utilisation des contrôles de source (Git, SVN, Perforce). Solides compétences en communication. Expérience dans le soutien et le mentorat des membres de l'équipe. Travailler en étroite collaboration avec d'autres disciplines de l'équipe pour améliorer les flux de travail et concrétiser la vision du jeu. Vous êtes passionné de jeux vidéo. Benefits À propos de Side Side (anciennement PTW) est un fournisseur mondial de services et de développement de jeux vidéo, proposant des solutions techniques et créatives à de nombreux développeurs et studios parmi les plus importants du monde. Fondée en 2009 et s’appuyant sur plus de 30 ans d’expérience de notre maison mère au Japon, Side est devenue une force mondiale avec 20 studios répartis dans 14 pays en Amérique du Nord, en Europe, en Amérique du Sud et en Asie. Nos services de pointe incluent le développement de jeux, la production artistique, la production audio, l'assurance qualité, la localisation, l'assurance qualité de la localisation, le support aux joueurs, la gestion de communauté et les ensembles de données. Aidez-nous à partager des histoires avec le monde entier! Rejoignez une équipe internationale de joueurs passionnés et contribuez à offrir des expériences de jeu inoubliables. Découvrez notre côté de la vie. Pour plus d'informations, rendez-vous sur https://www.side.inc/fr-ca. ===== SENIOR SOUND DESIGNER Purpose of Job: As a Senior Sound Designer at Side Montreal , your responsibilities will be crafting, developing, producing and integrating the sound environment for video games and other visual media and may include leading projects and mentoring team members. You will lead in sound and display your passion for video games which will enable you to build captivating soundscapes, providing players and spectators with an immersive experience. You will play a key role in bringing the creative vision to life, working in collaboration with audio staff and the game design team. Duties and Key Responsibilities: Designing and editing top quality sound assets for use in video games, trailers and other visual media, in respect to the project’s style and creative direction. Designing systems, through a deep understanding of middleware and game engines, allowing for dynamic mixing hierarchies and audio systems in both stereo and surround environments, in collaboration with the game design teams. Leading projects in planning, organizing sound design-related content, working closely with the creative director and project managers. Integrating sound assets in audio middleware (Wwise, FMOD) and game engines (Unreal, Unity, custom game engines). Syncing and mixing audio to linear media. Testing, finding and fixing audio related bugs. Understanding basic scripting as it pertains to game audio and workflow improvement. Working collaboratively, attend meetings with the team and external partners. Contributing to documentation, project tracking and procedures. Senior responsibilities: Provide mentorship and coaching to team members. Offer regular feedback and support professional development by monitoring and evaluating performance. Support in making informed decisions that impact operations and overall performance within the team. Identify opportunities for process improvements. Assist in the onboarding of new team members and ensure they are integrated smoothly into the business. Build and maintain strong relationships within the business. Other: Adhere to company Security, Confidentiality and Health and Safety procedures and ensure the compliance of the team. Adhere to the company IT and HR procedures and ensure the compliance of the team. Understand ethical behaviour and business practices, and ensure that own behaviour and the behaviour of others is consistent with these standards and aligns with the values of the organisation. Knowledge, Experience and Skills: Substantial experience in game sound design working in key positions for major projects that have shipped. Advanced knowledge in sound creation and highly proficient in using a DAW (Reaper or Pro Tools), in sync with visual material. Able to demonstrate a good understanding of the audio pipeline working with middleware and can execute advanced integration tasks in at least one game engine (UE5 preferably). Proficiency working with spreadsheets and collaboration tools, such as Confluence, Jira and Trello). Proficiency working with source controls (Git, SVN, Perforce). Strong communication skills. Experience in supporting, and mentoring team members. Working closely with other disciplines on the team to improve workflows and achieve vision for the game. You are passionate about video games. — About Side Side (formerly PTW) is a global video game development and services provider, offering technical and creative solutions to many of the largest developers and studios around the world. Founded in 2009 and drawing on 30+ years' experience from our parent company in Japan, Side has since grown to become a global force with 20 studios in 14 countries across North America, Europe, South America, and Asia. Our industry-leading services include game development, art production, audio production, quality assurance, localization, localization QA, player support, community management, and datasets. Help us bring stories to the world! Join a global team of passionate gamers and contribute to delivering unforgettable game experiences. Experience our side of life. For more information, visit www.side.inc .

https://gamejobs.co/Tech-Audio-Designer-.description: (Version française ci-dessous) With multiple awards to our name, Larian Studios has proven that we’re dedicated to delivering high-quality role-playing games. As we move on to new projects, the studio that brought you Baldur’s Gate 3 & Divinity: Original Sin 2 is looking for a Tech Audio Designer in Quebec to join the team and help us in crafting the high calibre games our fans have come to expect. Responsibilities - Execute the technical Audio Vision under the supervision of the Tech Audio Director. - Execute and maintain the entire audio pipeline, from asset production through implementation, integration, and deployment. - Communicate with stakeholders and feature groups to ensure smooth execution. - Design and implement Wwise systems. - Write and maintain scripts for the audio pipeline. - Support and mentor junior Tech Audio Team members. Requirements - Solid understanding of the Game Audio pipeline from asset creation to soundscape design. - Knowledge of scripting systems to develop customized, scalable automated solutions. - Build pipelines to support Sound Designers in delivering creative output. - Expertise in Wwise. - Exposure to or understanding of building Wwise plugins. - Experience working in the games industry. - Strong understanding of general audio production, including asset creation, mixing, and mastering. - Proficient in designing, developing, and maintaining node-based systems - Proficient with Python and C++ programming languages - A professional level of written and spoken English* What we offer: - An international team of over 6 00 employees spread across 7 studios around the world, each of which have their own unique qualities, and maintain a small-studio feel - An open, collaborative environment where ideas are welcome and encouraged - A managerial team consisting of highly experienced game developers at the top of their fields - Sharing hobbies and passions with like-minded colleagues - Inclusive environment with many activities organized by the studios or the employees - Commitment to making the best game possible for the fans, including listening to community feedback * Due to the global nature of our operations and the need to engage daily with an international team, fluency in English is essential for this position at Larian. ------------------------------------------ Maintes fois primé, Larian Studios a amplement démontré sa volonté de proposer des jeux de rôle de très haute qualité. À l’heure où le studio à l’origine de titres comme Baldur’s Gate 3 et Divinity: Original Sin 2 se tourne vers de nouveaux projets, nous sommes en quête d’un Concepteur sonore technique qui rejoindra l’équipe de Québec et nous aidera à créer les jeux d’excellence auxquels nos fans sont habitués. Responsabilités - Réaliser la vision technique de l’audio sous la supervision du directeur technique audio - Réaliser et maintenir le processus complet de développement de l’audio, de la création de ressources jusqu’à l’implémentation, l’intégration et le déploiement - Communiquer avec les parties prenantes et les équipes chargées des fonctionnalités pour garantir une réalisation sans heurts - Concevoir et mettre en œuvre des systèmes Wwise - Rédiger et maintenir des scripts pour le processus de développement de l’audio - Aider et mentorer les membres débutants de l’équipe technique audio Profil recherché - Une solide compréhension des processus de développement de l’audio d’un jeu vidéo, de la création des ressources jusqu’à la conception de l’environnement sonore - Une connaissance des systèmes de script afin de créer des solutions automatisées, sur mesure et évolutives - Une expérience dans la création de processus pour aider les concepteurs sonores à élaborer des propositions créatives - https://gracklehq.com/rd/382707.title: Stage - 6 mois - Sound designer (F/H/NB) [AAA Project]
https://gracklehq.com/rd/382707.description: Ubisoft est une référence mondiale du jeu vidéo, avec des équipes réparties aux quatre coins du monde qui créent des expériences de jeu originales et mémorables, de Assassin’s Creed à Rainbow Six en passant par Just Dance et bien d’autres encore. Nous croyons que la diversité des points de vue fait progresser à la fois les joueurs et les équipes. Si vous êtes passionné·e par l’innovation et que vous souhaitez repousser les limites du divertissement, rejoignez notre aventure et aidez-nous à créer l’inconnu ! Missions Création et édition de sound effects pour les différentes mécaniques et interactions du jeu. Enregistrement et traitement de sons à partir de prises de son ou de banques sonores. Édition, nettoyage et traitement audio dans Reaper . Intégration et implémentation des sons dans Wwise . Participation à la mise en place de systèmes audio interactifs et dynamiques. Recherche de solutions créatives et techniques pour répondre aux besoins du gameplay. Tests, débogage et optimisation des systèmes audio directement dans le jeu. Collaboration avec les équipes Game Design, Programming, Animation et Art. Participation à la documentation et à l'organisation des assets audio. Profil recherché personne passionnée par le jeu vidéo et le son , capable de combiner sensibilité artistique et intérêt pour les aspects techniques. Prérequis : Formation dans le jeu vidéo, l'audiovisuel, le son ou un domaine équivalent . Connaissance de Wwise . Connaissance de Unreal Engine . Bonne maîtrise des bases de l'édition audio sur Reaper . Connaissance des fondamentaux de la prise de son et de l'enregistrement audio . Bonne culture du jeu vidéo et compréhension de ses différents genres et mécaniques. Sensibilité au sound design et à la création sonore. Capacité à travailler de manière autonome sur des tâches définies. Maitrise de l'anglais à l'oral et à l'écrit. Qualités recherchées Proactif(ve) : capable de proposer des idées et de chercher des solutions plutôt que d'attendre systématiquement des instructions. Curieux(se) : envie d'explorer de nouveaux outils, techniques et approches du game audio. Technique : intérêt pour la compréhension des systèmes, du moteur et de l'implémentation audio. Créatif(ve) : capacité à proposer des concepts sonores originaux et pertinents pour le gameplay. Rigoureux(se) : attention portée à la qualité, à l'organisation et au détail. Autonome et capable de rechercher des solutions par soi-même. Esprit d'équipe et facilité à communiquer avec des profils artistiques et techniques. Passionné(e) de jeu vidéo et attentif(ve) à la manière dont le son participe à l'expérience du joueur. Un plus Pratique d'un ou plusieurs instruments de musique . Expérience en composition musicale ou production musicale. Expérience de prise de son / field recording . Notions de programmation ou de Blueprints dans Unreal Engine . Expérience sur un projet de jeu vidéo, même dans le cadre d'un projet étudiant ou personnel. Portfolio ou exemples de réalisations audio. Connaissance d'autres outils ou middleware audio. Stage 6 mois avec convention de stage obligatoire Location: Annecy – France Date de début: A pourvoir à partir d'octobre 2026 Fondé en 1996, Ubisoft Annecy a participé aux différents blockbusters à succès du groupe en collaborant notamment sur les sagas Splinter Cell, Assassin’s Creed®, mais aussi sur des parties de jeu à part entière telles que le raid de Tom Clancy’s : The Division 2® et Ghost Recon Wildlands. Nous sommes également fiers d’avoir développé notre propre IP, Steep puis Riders Republic ! Au-delà de nos productions AAA, nous contribuons à l’innovation technologique du groupe, grâce à notre pôle d’expertise technologique autour du moteur de jeux Snowdrop, ainsi que du Groupe Technologique en collaboration avec Ubisoft Montréal. Dans l’une des régions les plus dynamiques de France, Ubisoft s’est implanté dans un endroit idyllique entre lac et montagnes, au cœur de la Venise des Alpes à seulement 30 minutes de l’aéroport international de Genève. Fort d’un studio en perpétuelle croissance, nous mettons au centre de nos préoccupations l’engagement de nos collaborateur·trice·s et le travail d’équipe. Notre ambition se traduit par l’innovation et l’excellence pour un but ultime : la satisfaction de nos joueur·euse·s !

https://job-boards.eu.greenhouse.io/trip.title: Sound Designer
https://job-boards.eu.greenhouse.io/trip.description: Who are we? Tripledot Studios is one of the largest independent mobile games companies in the world. We are a multi-award-winning organisation, with a global 2,500+ strong team across 12 studios. Our expanded portfolio includes some of the biggest titles in mobile gaming, collectively reaching top chart positions around the world and engaging over 25 million daily active users. Tripledot’s guiding principle is that when people love what they do, what they do will be loved by others. We’re building a company we’re proud of. One filled with driven, incredibly smart and detail-orientated people, who LOVE making games. Our ambition is to be the most successful games company in the world, and we’re just getting started. The role is working within our studio: Tripledot Games About Tripledot Games Tripledot Games is a leading developer and publisher of casual and puzzle games, with a strong presence in London, Warsaw, and Barcelona. The studio is responsible for multiple top 10 titles, including Woodoku, Woodoku Blast, Solitaire, and TripleTile. Our best-in-class data-driven approach spans the entire lifecycle from publishing to machine learning puzzle levels, helping us make fast, smart decisions at every stage of development. We are also one of the largest IAA operators worldwide. Tripledot Games is a diverse and collaborative studio, home to people from over 36 nationalities. We take pride in our craftsmanship, strong focus on outcomes, and continuous improvement, building high-quality, scalable games that players around the world love. Role Overview As a Sound Designer at Tripledot Studios, you'll be responsible for creating, editing, and implementing audio components for our portfolio of games. You will collaborate with our creative teams to craft an immersive audio experience that compliments the game's visuals and gameplay. Key Responsibilities: Create original and engaging sound design for games, including gameplay actions, user interface interactions, animations, rewards, transitions, and other in-game moments. Take ownership of sound design across multiple features and projects, from initial concept through final delivery. Edit, mix, and master audio to produce polished, balanced results across different devices. Collaborate closely with game designers, artists, developers, producers, and other members of the audio team. Communicate effectively with international colleagues, particularly teams based in London, Barcelona, and Australia. Interpret creative briefs, propose suitable audio direction, and respond constructively to feedback. Review audio within the game, identify areas for improvement, and iterate until the sound supports the intended player experience. Organize audio assets and project files clearly, following consistent naming and delivery practices. Manage priorities and deliver high-quality work within agreed timelines. Contribute positively to team discussions and support a collaborative working environment. Requirements : Strong sound design, sound editing, and mixing skills. A good understanding of audio processing, including equalization, compression, dynamics, spatial effects, and level balancing. Proficiency with at least one professional digital audio workstation. Ability to create a complete audio experience using sound effects, audio libraries, voice-over, music, recording, layering, and creative processing. A strong ear for detail, timing, tonal balance, and how sound supports visual feedback and the player experience. Openness to learning and adopting new audio tools, technologies, and workflows. Ability to interpret a creative brief and independently develop an appropriate audio direction. Professional working proficiency in written and spoken English. Strong communication and collaboration skills, including confidence working with colleagues across different locations and time zones. Good organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple tasks or projects. A reliable and constructive approach to teamwork and feedback. Nice to Have Music composition and production skills, as it may occasionally be required. Previous experience creating audio for games, particularly mobile or casual games. An understanding of mobile audio limitations, file optimization, loudness, and playback consistency across devices. Experience with collaborative asset-management workflows. Working at Tripledot Hybrid Working 20 days of remote working: Work from anywhere in the world, or use the time to cover mandatory office days to WFH, 20 days of the year. Regular company events and rewards: Join in regular events and rewards that celebrate cultural events, our achievements, and our team spirit. Breakfast & Lunch: Relish daily breakfast and lunch provided in the office to keep you fueled and focused. BPJS HEALTH: Elevate your well-being and peace of mind, ensuring robust health security with seamless enrolment in BPJS Health. BPJS SOCIAL: Secure your employment rights with BPJS Social. Festivity Allowance: Celebrate festive occasions with an additional festive allowance. Private Health Insurance: Stay covered with comprehensive health insurance for you and your loved ones. Employee Assistance Program: Anytime you need it, tap into confidential, caring support with our Employee Assistance Program, always here to lend an ear and a helping hand. Family Forming Support: Receive vital support on your family forming/ fertility journey with our support program [subject to policy] English Classes: Enhance your English skills with our provided English classes

DeoVR is the leading immersive streaming technology serving multiple enterprise customers and millions of users globally. We are now expanding the boundaries of what video can be — moving from passive watching to active, interactive, multi-user journeys. If this excites you more than it scares you, you are in the right place. The Role We are looking for an Audio Editor for our video production team to elevate our post-production pipeline on a Pay-Per-Project basis. This role is focused purely on surgical audio cleanup and precise dialogue editing. You will take raw audio tracks recorded on set, strip away background noise, room echo, and unwanted artifacts, and cut out unnecessary spoken phrases, pauses, or overlapping speech to produce seamless, crystal-clear final audio synced to video. What You Will Do Perform precise audio restoration using advanced tools to eliminate background noise, room reverb, wind, clothing rustle, hums, clicks, and unwanted ambient sounds. Edit, cut, and trim audio tracks to remove unwanted spoken lines, awkward pauses, off-script phrases, or overlapping dialogue smoothly. Deliver clean, naturally sounding audio without audio artifacts, phase issues, or robotic noise-reduction tones. Balance output levels, apply basic dynamics/EQ, and deliver production-ready audio master files. What We Are Looking For Proven experience in audio editing and restoration for video post-production (YouTube, podcasts, interviews, TV, etc.). Proficiency in dedicated audio restoration software. https://jobs.smartrecruiters.com/CDPROJE.title: Senior Audio Design QA Analyst
https://jobs.smartrecruiters.com/CDPROJE.description: To create revolutionary, story-driven RPGs which go straight to the hearts of gamers — this is our mission. Want to dive deeper into our company’s culture? Explore our social media and check out our YouTube channel and Beyond the Game Blog where we share behind-the-scenes insights and stories direct from our team members! CD PROJEKT RED is looking for a Senior Audio Design QA Analyst to take ownership of quality across key areas of our game audio experience. In this role, you will work closely with Sound Design, Music and other Audio teams throughout development, helping define the quality bar, identify risks and ensure that audio supports gameplay, storytelling and the intended creative experience. You will combine a highly developed critical ear with strong QA expertise and a practical understanding of interactive audio implementation. As a Senior, you will go beyond identifying individual issues. You will drive complex audio quality topics to completion, establish effective testing approaches, provide informed quality recommendations, improve our QA practices and support the development of other team members. Responsibilities Take end-to-end responsibility for complex audio features, from early development through final release. Define test plans, coverage, and quality benchmarks across all audio domains (SFX, music, dialogue, ambience, systems, mix). Assess audio for both technical functionality and creative goals, prioritizing gameplay readability, immersion, and emotional impact. Diagnose complex issues across assets, logic, and systems using Wwise, Unreal Engine, and Blueprints. Partner with sound/music designers and programmers to communicate risks, offer feedback, and drive solutions. Lead testing efforts for major audio features, establishing priorities, validation approaches, and dedicated test environments. Provide data-driven quality recommendations and highlight critical blockers requiring pre-release fixes. Identify inefficiencies in audio QA processes and drive improvements to testing methodologies and tools. Elevate bug reporting quality, maintain documentation, and mentor junior team members on audio testing practices. Research advances in interactive audio and modern QA practices to continually refine evaluation methods. 5+ years of professional experience in game QA, audio, or a relevant development discipline, with a track record of owning quality for complex systems throughout the production cycle. Critical listening skills to evaluate audio beyond basic functionality, ensuring consistency, balance, creative intent, and alignment with the player experience. Deep understanding of interactive game audio systems, including sound effects, ambience, music, and dialogue, and how they interact during gameplay. Proficiency in Wwise (or comparable middleware) and modern game engines like Unreal Engine, with the ability to investigate implementation-related audio issues. Experience creating and maintaining robust test strategies, test plans, and structured coverage for complex features. Ability to assess quality risks and player impact, prioritize issues effectively, and communicate clear recommendations. Ability to provide detailed, constructive, and actionable feedback to both creative and technical specialists. Experience improving QA workflows, testing approaches, and mentoring less experienced team members. Strong spoken and written English. Nice to have Professional background in Sound Design, Technical Sound Design, or Audio Implementation, with experience shipping at least one PC or console title. Strong command of audio production fundamentals, including mixing, dynamics, and signal flow. Experience with standard DAWs like Reaper or Pro Tools. Expertise in 3D/spatial audio systems and testing complex interactive audio (music, dialogue, ambience). Experience with accessibility and gameplay readability considerations, as well as evaluating audio across diverse hardware and playback environments. Proven ability to coordinate testing with external QA teams and build custom test maps or debug tools for audio validation. Working mode Office-First: working primarily from the Warsaw studio in a full time or hybrid mode. Relocation Support Relocation package – flight ticket, company apartment for your first month, relocating your pet, shipping your belongings — it’s all covered. Relocation assistance — processing your legalization operations for you, assistance with finding residence, tax settlements — all you need to feel right at home is taken care of. Polish lessons for foreign employees — and for your spouse or partner, too. Health & Well-Being Private medical healthcare — a selection of medical plans with dental care and unlimited rehabilitation to choose from, which are also accessible for your partner and relatives. Life insurance — comprehensive pension and insurance plans to protect you and your loved ones. Annual screenings for cancer prevention covered by the company. Psychological and psychiatrist care — free mental health support and various well-being initiatives. Sports card — gain access to a wide number of sporting and fitness facilities across the city. Menstrual leave — employees who menstruate can take one extra day off when experiencing period pain. RED Parents Network — support for working parents, including childcare benefits, and family-friendly events. RED Summer Camp for Kids — a fun summer program for children aged 5–12, majoritively paid by the company. Perks & Professional Growth A welcome pack filled with goodies — to help you feel right at home once you join the team. Trainings, lectures, and courses — workshops and trainings for each employee, knowledge-sharing initiatives, online tutorials, and e-learning classes are all available. There’s always something to learn! REDs have access to the cafeteria platform through which they can receive subscription benefits, additional medical packages or vouchers and codes to shops, cinemas, and public transport reimbursement. Gifts for newborn rebels and regular chances to nab some cool swag! Social Activities & Life in the Office Dog-friendly office — dog owner? Bring your pooch with you and look after them while working! There’s always a furry friend or two to meet at the studio. Social events — we host regular gatherings at the studio where we can all unwind, play games, and just have some fun together. Healthy selections — ​​canteens. Truly international working environment — a chance to meet and work with a diverse selection of people from all around the world. Sustainability is an ongoing commitment for us, and our campus has  electric car charging points, green zones, and much more. Read all about it on our Beyond the Game Blog. A designated space for your bicycle, as well as bicycle repair equipment and showers available whenever you need them. An onsite, well-equipped gym with a climbing wall, daily Gym Assistant support, and yoga and boxing classes. No dress-code — we like to keep it casual. Estimated pay range for this position: 14 200 - 24 400 PLN gross monthly. Final offers are dependent on job-related factors like experience and qualifications. Contract type in Poland: Employment contract (umowa o pracę) If you've observed any irregularities (i.e. legal or ethical violations) in our recruitment process, please click here to report them anonymously. #LI_Hybrid

https://gamejobs.co/Concepteur-Sonore-So.title: Concepteur Sonore / Sound Designer
https://gamejobs.co/Concepteur-Sonore-So.description: //See English version below...// Poste: Concepteur sonore Montréal, Canada Objectif du Poste: En tant que concepteur sonore, vos responsabilités comprennent la création, le développement, la production et l'intégration de l'environnement sonore des jeux vidéo et autres médias visuels. Votre expertise sonore et votre passion pour les jeux vidéo en particulier vous permettent de construire des paysages sonores captivants, offrant aux joueurs et aux spectateurs une expérience immersive. Vous jouez un rôle clé dans la concrétisation de la vision créative, en travaillant en collaboration avec l'équipe audio senior et l'équipe de conception du jeu. Liste des responsabilités Dans le cadre de ses fonctions, le concepteur sonore est appelé à effectuer plusieurs tâches, notamment : ● Concevoir et éditer des ressources sonores attrayantes pour les jeux vidéo, les bandes-annonces et autres médias visuels, dans le respect du style et de la direction créative du projet ; ● Intégration d'assets sonores dans des middlewares audio (Wwise, FMOD) et des moteurs de jeux (Unreal, Unity, moteurs de jeux personnalisés) ; ● Concevoir des hiérarchies de mixage dynamiques et des systèmes audio dans des environnements stéréo et surround ; ● Synchronisation et mixage audio sur des supports linéaires ; ● Tester, trouver et corriger les bogues liés à l'audio ; ● Maintenir une familiarité avec les scripts de base en ce qui concerne l'audio du jeu et l'amélioration du flux de travail ; ● Travailler en collaboration, assister aux réunions avec l'équipe et les partenaires externes ; ● Contribuer à la documentation, au suivi des projets et aux procédures ; ● Exécuter des sessions d'enregistrement à l'intérieur et à l'extérieur du studio Requirements Formation et expérience ● Diplôme dans une discipline en lien avec le poste (design sonore, enregistrement, musique) ● Expérience ayant travaillé sur au moins deux jeux terminés ● Ou avoir un portfolio/démo impressionnant Compétences et qualités ● Vous faites preuve d'une excellente créativité dans la création sonore ; ● Vous maîtrisez l'utilisation d'un DAW (Reaper et/ou Pro Tools) à des fins de conception sonore, en synchronisation avec le matériel visuel. ● Vous êtes créatif, curieux, humble, vous savez accepter les critiques constructives et vous avez l'esprit d'équipe. ● Vous travaillez efficacement et êtes soucieux du temps ; ● Vous êtes doué pour gérer le stress, respecter les échéanciers et les calendriers changeants. ● Vous avez un sens aigu de l'organisation, de la débrouillardise et de l'autonomie. ● Vous êtes de nature positive. ● Vous parlez couramment le français et l'anglais. ● Vous êtes passionné de jeux vidéo. ● Vous avez une bonne compréhension du pipeline audio en travaillant avec Wwise et pouvez exécuter des tâches d'intégration de base dans au moins un moteur de jeu (Unreal ou Unity). Valeur ajoutée (facultatif) ● Expérience en gestion de projet ● Maîtrise du mélange avec les médias linéaires ● Compétences en tableurs ● Compétences en codage ● Connaissance du contrôle de code source (Git, SVN, Perforce) ● Certification de formation Wwise Durée et horaire ● Emploi permanent ● 40 heures par semaine ● Le candidat sélectionné travaillera en personne au studio de SIDE Montréal Procédure de dépôt de votre demande ● Toutes les questions peuvent être envoyées à jobs@vibeavenue.com ● La demande doit contenir les éléments suivants : ○ Un CV . ○ Une lettre de motivation ○ Un portfolio contenant une bande démo et démontrant vos compétences en matière de conception sonore, de mixage et/ou d'intégration audio. ■ Si vous n'envoyez pas de portfolio, votre candidature sera rejetée. ■ Veuillez envoyer du contenu qui nous permet d'évaluer vos compétences audio uniquement. Les cinématiques avec de la musique forte ne nous fournissent pas suffisamment d'informations. ○ Le cas échéant, des liens Web vers des jeux sur lesquels vous avez travaillé, des vidéos commentées de vos projets audio interactifs ou tout autre élément qui vous aiderait à vous démarquer. ○ Lettre de recommandation (facultatif) ● Seul(s) le(s) candidat(s) sélectionné(s) sera (seront) convoqué(s) pour un test de conception sonore et un entretien. Benefits À propos de Side : Side (anciennement PTW) est un fournisseur mondial de services et de développement de jeux vidéo, proposant des solutions techniques et créatives à de nombreux développeurs et studios parmi les plus importants du monde. Fondée en 2009 et s’appuyant sur plus de 30 ans d’expérience de notre maison mère au Japon, Side est devenue une force mondiale avec 20 studios répartis dans 14 pays en Amérique du Nord, en Europe, en Amérique du Sud et en Asie.Nos services de pointe incluent le développement de jeux, la production artistique, la production audio, l'assurance qualité, la localisation, l'assurance qualité de la localisation, le support aux joueurs, la gestion de communauté et les ensembles de données. Aidez-nous à partager des histoires avec le monde entier! Rejoignez une équipe internationale de joueurs passionnés et contribuez à offrir des expériences de jeu inoubliables. Découvrez notre côté de la vie. Pour plus d'informations, rendez-vous sur https://www.side.inc/fr-ca . ===== Role: Sound Designer Montreal, Canada Purpose of Job: As a Sound Designer, your responsibilities include crafting, developing, producing and integrating the sound environment for video games and other visual media. Your expertise in sound and passion for video games in particular enable you to build captivating soundscapes, providing players and spectators with an immersive experience. You play a key role in bringing the creative vision to life, working in collaboration with senior audio staff and the game design team. List of responsibilities As part of their duties, Sound Designers are required to perform several tasks including: ● Designing and editing engaging sound assets for use in video games, trailers and other visual media, in respect to the project’s style and creative direction; ● Integrating sound assets in audio middleware (Wwise, FMOD) and game engines (Unreal, Unity, custom game engines); ● Designing dynamic mixing hierarchies and audio systems in both stereo and surround environments; ● Syncing and mixing audio to linear media; ● Testing, finding and fixing audio related bugs; ● Maintaining a familiarity with basic scripting as it pertains to game audio and workflow improvement; ● Working collaboratively, attend meetings with the team and external partners; ● Contributing to documentation, project tracking and procedures; ● Execute recording sessions inside and outside of the studio Education and Experience ● Degree in a discipline related to the position (sound design, recording, music) ● Experience having worked on at least two completed games ● Or have an impressive portfolio/demo Competences and qualities ● You show excellent creativity in sound creation; ● You are proficient in using a DAW (Reaper and/or Pro Tools) for sound design purposes, in sync with visual material. ● You are creative, curious, humble, good at accepting constructive criticism and a great team player. ● You work efficiently and are time conscious; ● You are good at managing stress, respecting shifting timelines and schedules. ● You have a sharpened sense of organization, resourcefulness and autonomy. ● You are positive in nature. ● You are fluent in French and English. ● You are passionate about video games. ● You have a good understanding of the audio pipeline working with Wwise and can execute basic integration tasks in at least one game engine (Unreal or Unity). Added value (optional) ● Experience in project management ● Mixing proficiency with linear media ● Spreadsheets skills ● Coding skills ● Knowledge of source control (Git, SVN, Perforce) ● Wwise training certification Duration and schedule ● Permanent employment ● 40 hours per week ● The selected candidate will work in person at SIDE Montreal’s studio Procedure to submit your application ● All questions can be sent to jobs@vibeavenue.com ● The application must contain the following: ○ A resume . ○ A cover letter ○ A Portfolio containing a Demo Reel and demonstrating your sound design, mixing and/or audio integration skills. ■ If you do not send a portfolio, your application will be rejected. ■ Please send content that allows us to evaluate your audio skills only. Cinematics with loud music do not provide us with sufficient information. ○ If applicable, Web links to games you've worked on, commented videos of your interactive audio projects or anything else that would help you stand out. ○ Reference letter (optional) ● Only the candidates(s) selected will be called for a sound design test and interview. About Side Side (formerly PTW) is a global video game development and services provider, offering technical and creative solutions to many of the largest developers and studios around the world. Founded in 2009 and drawing on 30+ years' experience from our parent company in Japan, Side has since grown to become a global force with 20 studios in 14 countries across North America, Europe, South America, and Asia. Our industry-leading services include game development, art production, audio production, quality assurance, localization, localization QA, player support, community management, and datasets. Help us bring stories to the world! Join a global team of passionate gamers and contribute to delivering unforgettable game experiences. Experience our side of life. For more information, visit www.side.inc .

https://jobs.smartrecruiters.com/Ubisoft.description: Ubisoft is a global leader in gaming with teams across the world creating original and memorable gaming experiences, from Assassin’s Creed, Rainbow Six, to Just Dance and more. We believe diverse perspectives help both players and teams thrive. If you’re passionate about innovation and pushing entertainment boundaries, join our journey and help us create the unknown! Develop at Ubisoft is a mentorship program for students and recent graduates (with less than two years of experience) looking to grow their skills in Game Design, Audio, Programming, or Cybersecurity. This initiative supports individuals from genders historically underrepresented in gaming and STEM. Develop at Ubisoft is one of several talent programs we offer to engage and support different audiences across the industry. Please note: this program is a mentorship program and is not tied to any hiring process. From January to May 2027, selected mentees will work on a project based on a given theme. They will be mentored by volunteer Ubisoft developers, including from our mobile studios, who will provide feedback and guidance throughout the mentorship to help them develop their own personal project. In the Audio track , you will create and submit an original sound design using a freely available middleware tool, Wwise. You will design and integrate audio for specific events — for example, animations, ambiences, and interactive elements — ensuring the sound design fits the overall visual style. Eligibility criteria: At least 18 years old Currently enrolled in studies, or graduated in Spring 2024 or later Fewer than 2 years of professional experience Legally entitled to work in the country of application Applications may be submitted to only one location Individual entries only – team entries will not be considered Additional criteria for Toronto applicants: Must be a student or recent graduate Must be a resident of Ontario Must have attended a recognized school, college or university in Ontario This program is designed to support early-career professionals from underrepresented genders – female and nonbinary – in the industry. By submitting an application, you confirm that you meet and accept the eligibility criteria outlined above. Apply with your resume, cover letter and, if available, a portfolio . Please also select your preferred track and location . Application period: October 1st –  October 31st We are looking for mentees in the locations where our participating studios are based: Bulgaria (Sofia); Canada (Toronto); Germany (Berlin, Düsseldorf, Mainz); Singapore; Sweden (Malmö - Massive Entertainment);

Proven track record of owning quality, stability, and performance for technical features throughout the development cycle. Strong practical knowledge of Unreal Engine and C++, with the ability to read, investigate, and debug production code. Proficiency with audio middleware like Wwise, including technical debugging and performance profiling. Expertise in using diagnostic and profiling tools such as Unreal Insights, PIX, or Razor to analyze performance data, logs, and traces. Experience designing and implementing automated or programmatic testing solutions, pipelines, and internal tools. Demonstrated ability to perform root-cause analysis across complex systems to identify and resolve technical issues. Skill in designing comprehensive test strategies and coverage plans for technically complex features. Ability to assess technical quality risks and data-driven insights to make actionable recommendations. Nice to have Professional experience in game audio technology, technical audio, or Audio QA with a shipped PC or console title. Hands-on programming experience, including implementing fixes, tooling, or production features. Expertise in creating test frameworks, internal QA tools, and custom testing infrastructure. Experience with automated testing integrated into CI or development pipelines. Strong understanding of audio programming concepts (DSP, mixing, streaming, voice management) and engine-level performance optimization. Advanced Wwise skills, including integration, optimization, and complex profiling. Experience creating debug levels, instrumentation, or visualization tools for complex systems. Polish lessons for foreign employees — and for your spouse or partner, too. Life insurance — comprehensive pension and insurance plans to protect you and your loved ones. Annual screenings for cancer prevention covered by the company. Psychological and psychiatrist care — free mental health support and various well-being initiatives. Sports card — gain access to a wide number of sporting and fitness facilities across the city. Menstrual leave — employees who menstruate can take one extra day off when experiencing period pain. RED Parents Network — support for working parents, including childcare benefits, and family-friendly events. RED Summer Camp for Kids — a fun summer program for children aged 5–12, majority paid by the company. Trainings, lectures, and courses — workshops and trainings for each employee, knowledge-sharing initiatives, online tutorials, and e-learning classes are all available. REDs have access to the cafeteria platform through which they can receive subscription benefits, additional medical packages or vouchers and codes to shops, cinemas, and public transport reimbursement. Gifts for newborn rebels and regular chances to nab some cool swag! Social Activities & Life in the Office Dog-friendly office — dog owner? Social events — we host regular gatherings at the studio where we can all unwind, play games, and just have some fun together. Healthy selections — ​​canteens. Truly international working environment — a chance to meet and work with a diverse selection of people from all around the world. A designated space for your bicycle, as well as bicycle repair equipment and showers available whenever you need them. An onsite, well-equipped gym with a climbing wall, daily Gym Assistant support, and yoga and boxing classes. No dress-code — we like to keep it casual. https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/hoyoverse/2bcf6.description: HoYoverse is committed to providing immersive virtual world experiences to players around the world. We have brought fans popular games including Genshin Impact, Honkai: Star Rail, Honkai Impact 3rd, Tears of Themis, and Zenless Zone Zero, as well as a wide range of entertainment content. Community is at the heart of everything we do. We are devoted to engaging fans and fostering an enthusiastic and inclusive global community. Pushing the boundaries of imagination, we consistently explore cutting-edge game development technologies. In the future, we will continue to expand our content production, technology research, and publishing duties through operations in offices in Singapore, Montreal, Los Angeles, Tokyo, Seoul, and other areas. When you apply to a position with HoYoverse, we will process your personal data. To learn more, please review our comprehensive Global Applicant and Candidate Privacy Policy . About the Role We are building a game where narrative is discovered through both traditional means like cutscene, and emergent gameplay elements like dialogue choices. We’re looking for someone to help craft a coherent audio story that stitches intermittent parts together to deliver a unified experience. You will be working with gameplay, narrative, and art in order to both figure out the experience that we’re want to deliver to players, as well as the internal processes used to create this non-linear story. This requires resourcefulness, clear communication, and someone who deeply understands how games feel from the player's side. You will partner with quest designers, technical designers, and engineers to build the audio functions and logic needed to deliver this experience. You will also work with and guide our in-house audio talent, elevating the audio experience through a mixture of your work and mentorship. What you will do: • Co-create the audio vision for narrative cohesion. Craft and implement dynamic, audio systems in Wwise and UE5 to make branching gameplay feel like an authored experienced. • Collaborate with designers across disciplines, including gameplay, systems, quest, and narrative to identify where story emerges through play. Propose audio solutions that surface and strengthen those moments. • Help the team identify risks and keep the audio vision moving forward even when the broader design is still taking shape. • Partner with technical personnel, including tools engineers and audio programmers. Translate the needs of systemic narrative design into clear technical requirements for our audio tools and pipelines. • Establish and document best practices for systemic audio design, creating shared language and process across the team. • Play the game relentlessly, and identify stylistic inconsistencies, dead zones, and poor transitions. Advocate for the audio experience across disciplines. What we're looking for: Required: • 5+ years of game audio design experience • A portfolio/demo reel demonstrating systemic or non-linear audio design. Show us how your audio adapts to player choice, state changes, or emergent gameplay. • Mastery of dynamic audio implementation in a modern game engine (Unreal Engine 5 strongly preferred). • Expertise with Wwise or FMOD, especially for large-scale projects with multiple systems and complex routing. • A strong personal relationship with games. You play widely, think critically about how games work, and understand how audio shapes the player's experience from the inside. • Excellent communication skills, capable of inspiring others with a creative vision and clearly explaining technical needs to engineering partners. Preferred (Nice-to-Haves): • Experience on shipped branching narrative games, open-world titles, immersive sims, or games where story emerges through systems. • Experience mentoring other audio designers or providing creative feedback. • Familiarity with the technical pipelines and tools used in quest or narrative scripting (e.g., visual scripting, dialogue systems). Why Join Us? • No one on the team has done this exact thing before. You will help navigate this challenge with a team that’s eager to explore how to deliver storytelling in this form. • You won't be handed a brief. We protect time for deep creative work and trust you to find the path forward. • Dedicated tools engineers help to build the technical capabilities required to deliver the audio experience. • Help define what systemic narrative audio means for our project and accumulate experience in this front for the next generation of designers on our team. How to Apply Please submit your resume and a link to your narrative-focused portfolio/reel . In your application, please include: A brief analysis of a game where audio successfully created cohesion across branching or emergent gameplay. What did the audio do? How do you think the systems were designed? What would you have done differently? The base pay range for this position is $135,000 to $175,000 USD per year (Los Angeles only). Actual pay is based on location and may vary depending on relevant knowledge, skills, and experience from the candidate. Total compensation may include salary, company bonuses, sign-on bonuses, relocation package, and other benefits such as: 100% employer-paid healthcare premiums for you and your dependents Generous paid time off 401K / RRSP plan Employer-paid life and disability insurance Team-building activities throughout the year Flexible working hours We are an equal opportunity employer that believes diverse backgrounds are key to bringing our concepts to life. If you're looking to play a key role in creating the best immersive virtual world experience for our users, we invite you to join our team.

https://job-boards.greenhouse.io/naughty.title: Sound Design Implementer
https://job-boards.greenhouse.io/naughty.description: This position is for temporary engagement through our staffing partner, Yoh Enterprise Solutions. Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States for this position. This is a hybrid / onsite position. For nearly 40 years, Naughty Dog has been crafting best-selling, critically acclaimed games that constantly push the boundaries of narrative, gameplay, and technology. Naughty Dog recently released The Last of Us Part II Remastered as well as a current generation remake of The Last of Us Part I for the PS5. We're also proud to say that The Last of Us Part I and Part II are now available for the first time on PC. Currently, we’re busy at the kennel working on Intergalactic: The Heretic Prophet, and we'd love to find talented individuals to join us! Naughty Dog games have long been lauded for their evocative, character-driven stories and attention to detail. We are committed to innovation within our games and as such have curated some of the top creative and technically innovative minds in the industry. We welcome diverse candidates and believe that a broad range of cultural and life experiences contribute to the overall well-being and success of the studio and the titles we craft together. Naughty Dog is seeking an enthusiastic and disciplined individual to join our audio team. The bulk of the work will be tagging animations with our proprietary in-house tools. The ideal candidate possesses a strong sense of timing, rhythm and a focused attention to detail. In addition you may work within our other systems to assist in setting up audio regions for environmental audio. This is not a design position. What you will do: Coordinating and implementing character based sounds (Foley) within animation sets Working closely with the Audio Lead and sound design staff to implement sound effects on animations Collaborating with Animation team to stay on top of iterative material and respond accordingly Implementing effort vocalizations of characters within specific animation sets What skills you will use: A fundamental knowledge of sound design and sound editing - most importantly, the timing and placement of sounds in relation to visuals Possess technical proficiency including the ability to handle text files, light scripting capabilities, asset management, and proprietary game tools Demonstrate solid writing and communication skills Clearly and concisely define game critical issues, problem solving capabilities Quickly adapt to change, help to find creative solutions and maintain positive momentum in the face of adversity Maintain AAA quality work within an aggressive schedule deadline driven environment Bonus Skills: Shipped a game at any level #LI-AB1 At SIE, working with our partners, we consider several factors when setting each role’s base pay range, including the competitive benchmarking data for the market and geographic location. Please note that the individual base pay range may vary based on job-related factors which may include knowledge, skills, experience, and location. In addition, this role is eligible for benefit offerings that include medical, dental, and vision. Click here to learn more. The estimated base pay range for this role is listed below, this is an hourly rate. $45.77 — $57.21 USD Please note, Sony Interactive Entertainment conducts background checks at the offer stage for all new employees (which may include criminal background checks for some roles) and will need to process personal information to support these checks. Please refer to our Candidate Privacy Notice for more information about what personal information we collect, how we use it, who we share it with, and your data protection rights.

https://job-boards.greenhouse.io/hasbro/.title: Senior Sound Technical Designer
https://job-boards.greenhouse.io/hasbro/.description: We take play seriously. We’re looking for curious adventurers ready to find their party, fueled by imagination and drive to build what’s never been built before. At Hasbro and Wizards of the Coast, you’ll collaborate with passionate teams to reimagine our iconic brands and create experiences that spark joy, connection, and community through the magic of play. This is your chance to shape legendary play that lasts a lifetime. Step Into the Multiverse: Your Next Adventure Starts Here At Wizards of the Coast , we harness the power of imagination and connection to create unforgettable experiences. We create entertainment that inspires creativity, sparks passion, forges friendships, and fosters communities around the globe. In every pursuit our mission is to inspire a lifetime love of games. Whether it's through the strategic depth of Magic: The Gathering® , the rich storytelling of Dungeons & Dragons® , or our AAA digital game studios, we build worlds that bring people together, spark creativity, and fuel adventure. As we continue to grow and explore new realms, we're seeking passionate, curious, and innovative minds to join the adventure. We are looking for a Senior Technical Sound Designer to join our digital game team at Wizards of the Coast. This role is anticipated to be a hybrid work position, with some work on-site and some work from home. What You’ll Do Design and develop features, tools, and workflows that align with the game’s creative vision and enhance production efficiency, in collaboration with the Audio Director and key stakeholders. Partner with cross-discipline technical experts to streamline processes, improve integration, and elevate overall product quality. Collaborate with game engineers to implement scalable and reliable audio pipelines that support production at all stages. Optimize audio assets and development workflows to meet the evolving technical and creative needs of the project. Identify and troubleshoot issues across disciplines, providing clear technical solutions and support to team members. Author and maintain documentation outlining workflows, standards, and best practices for consistency and knowledge sharing. Work closely with QA teams to investigate, escalate, and track audio-related bugs, ensuring timely resolution of critical issues. Proactively monitor and address performance and memory challenges, maintaining audio quality and player immersion without compromising efficiency. Create audio content when required, applying strong sound design skills and proficiency with both commercial and proprietary tools. Stay current with emerging audio technologies and innovations, translating them into technical direction and motivation for the audio team and project. What You’ll Bring 5+ years of combined experience in the game industry as a Technical Sound Designer, deep familiar workflows as a Sound Designer, all contributing to high-quality game audio experiences. Proficient with AAA game engines, on the current pulse of emerging audio technology with a strong command of audio implementation and integration workflows/ Advanced expertise in MetaSound and Wwise, including setup, optimization, and troubleshooting within complex game environments. Experience with Unreal Engine, Blueprint scripting, and engine tools that support  large scale audio implementation and authoring. Proven experience designing and developing custom audio workflows and tools to enhance production efficiency. Highly collaborative, with a demonstrated ability to partner effectively across departments and foster a strong team dynamic. Comfortable with scripting and level design tools, and well-versed in end-to-end game development pipelines across disciplines. Self-driven and proactive problem-solver, adaptable to feedback and capable of responding quickly to evolving project needs. Excellent communicator, both written and verbal, with the ability to clearly convey technical and creative concepts. What Sets You Apart Familiarity with coding or scripting (e.g., C++, Python, C#, or similar) is a plus Passion for video games and strong understanding of game audio industry. Experience in larger AAA games and the phases of development Employees may be eligible for annual and long-term incentives as part of their overall compensation package, depending on role, location, and eligibility. Benefits and programs may include: Health & Wellness Time Off to Recharge Financial Well-being Life & Family Support Volunteer and Community Initiatives Learning & Development Exclusive Perks Please review our Applicant Privacy Notice to learn how we collect, use, and protect your personal information in connection with the application process.

https://jobs.smartrecruiters.com/CDPROJE.title: Lead Sound Designer
https://jobs.smartrecruiters.com/CDPROJE.description: To create revolutionary, story-driven RPGs which go straight to the hearts of gamers — this is our mission. Want to dive deeper into our company’s culture? Explore our social media and check out our YouTube channel and Beyond the Game Blog where we share behind-the-scenes insights and stories direct from our team members! CD PROJEKT RED is looking for an experienced Lead Sound Designer to join our studio in Warsaw to drive audio development of Witcher 4. As a Lead Sound Designer, you will be responsible for leading the Sound Design team and collaborating with cross-discipline teams to create and deliver an immersive audio experience for our upcoming game. If you are an accomplished game audio artist and experienced leader with a passion for crafting soundscapes for widely respected, narrative-driven RPGs, we want to hear from you! Daily Responsibilities: Lead a team of Sound Designers and drive game audio development in the project. Help define and maintain aesthetic continuity throughout the game and trailers, in alignment with previous releases in the IP where appropriate. Collaborate closely with project Directors, Leads, Producers, and cross-discipline teams (Music, VO, Programmers) to craft immersive, high-quality, and technologically advanced audio experiences. Plan, revise, track, and execute milestones, sprints, and roadmap deliverables. Support and coach team members to achieve impactful and high-quality in-game results while fostering their growth and development. Support the design and development of innovative audio systems using Unreal Engine 5, Wwise middleware, and in-house tools. Design, implement, and mix original and rich sound effects. 7+ years of professional experience in the video game industry, with involvement in multiple shipped AAA titles. At least 2 years of experience in a leadership role related to sound design or audio direction. Strong creative skills and a focus on quality, evidenced by a portfolio, demo reel, or game credits. Collaborative approach to navigating challenges and resolving design obstacles. Exceptional artistic and creative competence. Effective cross-disciplinary communication skills. Ability to manage timelines and coordinate with teams. Skilled communicator experienced in collaborating across development teams and providing supportive leadership to direct reports. Nice to Have: (These skills are not required to apply for the position) Experience with Atmos, Surround Sound, 3D Audio, and HRTF. Experience working with performance capture. Experience planning and executing field and Foley recording sessions. Working mode In-office in a hybrid or full-time capacity in Warsaw, Poland. Relocation is required. Relocation Support Relocation package — flight ticket, company apartment for your first month, relocating your pet and family, shipping your belongings. It’s all covered. Relocation assistance — processing your legalization operations for you and  tax settlements — all you need to feel right at home is taken care of. Polish lessons for foreign employees — and for your spouse or partner, too. Paid Leave — from 20 to 26 days of holiday per year, and paid sick leave. Health & Well-Being Private medical healthcare — a selection of medical plans with dental care and unlimited rehabilitation to choose from, which are also accessible for your partner and relatives. Life insurance — comprehensive pension and insurance plans to protect you and your loved ones. Annual screenings for cancer prevention covered by the company. Psychological and psychiatrist care — free mental health support and various well-being initiatives. Sports card — gain access to a wide number of sporting and fitness facilities across the city. Menstrual leave — employees who menstruate can take one extra day off when experiencing period pain. RED Parents Network — support for working parents, including childcare benefits, and family-friendly events. RED Summer Camp for Kids — a fun summer program for children aged 5–12, majoritively paid by the company. Perks & Professional Growth A welcome pack filled with goodies — to help you feel right at home once you join the team. Trainings, lectures, and courses — workshops and trainings for each employee, knowledge-sharing initiatives, online tutorials, and e-learning classes are all available. There’s always something to learn! REDs have access to the cafeteria platform through which they can receive subscription benefits, additional medical packages or vouchers and codes to shops, cinemas, and public transport reimbursement. Gifts for newborn rebels and regular chances to nab some cool swag! Social Activities & Life in the Office Dog-friendly office — dog owner? Bring your pooch with you and look after them while working! There’s always a furry friend or two to meet at the studio. Social events — we host regular gatherings at the studio where we can all unwind, play games, and just have some fun together. Healthy selections — ​​canteens. Truly international working environment — a chance to meet and work with a diverse selection of people from all around the world. Sustainability is an ongoing commitment for us, and our campus has  electric car charging points, green zones, and much more. Read all about it on our Beyond the Game Blog . A designated space for your bicycle, as well as bicycle repair equipment and showers available whenever you need them. An onsite, well-equipped gym with a climbing wall, daily Gym Assistant support, and yoga and boxing classes. No dress-code — we like to keep it casual. Estimated pay range for this position: 31 800 – 43 725 PLN gross monthly. This role may be eligible for a long term incentive program (option to purchase CDPR stock after the vesting period). Final offers are dependent on job-related factors like experience and qualifications. Type of contract: Employment Contract ("Umowa o pracę"). If you've observed any irregularities (i.e. legal or ethical violations) in our recruitment process, please click here to report them anonymously. #LI-Hybrid

https://jobs.gohire.io/shiftUrl.php?d=aH.title: Sound Designer
https://jobs.gohire.io/shiftUrl.php?d=aH.description: Makeshift Software Inc | Remote (3–6 months) → Hybrid On-Site Full-Time About Hexborn Hexborn is our upcoming dark fantasy action RPG — a brutal blend of hack-and-slash combat, deep dungeon crawling, guild progression, and player-driven rivalry set in a world consumed by an ever-expanding corruption known as the Graveglass Blight. Players rise from an unknown mage into the leader of a legendary guild, mastering arcane combat, recruiting allies, forging relics, and descending into cursed ruins and large-scale raids to uncover the truth behind their rare ability to fly. The demo is live now on Steam, we advise you to try it before applying. We're building a world that should feel as oppressive and alive through sound as it does visually — The Blight's corruption, the weight of combat, the tension of a raid going sideways. We need a sound designer who can make Hexborn's world sound as dangerous as it looks. The Role We're looking for an experienced Sound Designer to own sound design and implementation for Hexborn — combat impacts, environmental atmosphere, spell and ability audio, and the ambient dread of the Graveglass Blight itself. You'll be responsible for both crafting the sounds themselves and implementing them in-engine using Sonity , our adaptive audio middleware for Unity, so combat and exploration audio respond dynamically to what's actually happening on screen. This is a hands-on, high-ownership role. You won't just be delivering static audio files — you'll be building adaptive, layered soundscapes and combat feedback that hold up across long dungeon crawls and large-scale raid encounters. What You'll Do Design and implement sound effects for combat, spells, VFX, and enemy behavior — using synthesis and foley recording to build original, layered sounds rather than relying solely on stock libraries Build environmental and ambient soundscapes for dungeons, ruins, and Blight-corrupted environments Implement adaptive, dynamic audio using Sonity within Unity Design combat audio that scales cleanly across large raid encounters with many simultaneous sound sources Collaborate closely with combat designers, VFX artists, and animators to ensure audio, visuals, and feedback land together Maintain and organize our sound asset library and implementation standards as the game's scope grows Work within our broader workflow tooling: see our tools list What You'll Need Proven professional experience in game sound design Hands-on experience with Sonity or comparable adaptive/interactive audio middleware ( Wwise , FMOD ) — Sonity experience strongly preferred given our current pipeline Expertise in sound synthesis , for building custom and layered SFX rather than relying solely on library assets Expertise in foley , with hands-on experience recording and editing practical sound sources Strong technical understanding of implementing audio inside Unity A portfolio or reel demonstrating combat, environmental, and ambient sound design Experience designing audio that scales well in busy, high-entity-count scenes (combat encounters, raids) Comfort working independently in a small, fast-moving team where you'll own your domain end-to-end Perks & Tools MOVE AI markerless motion capture + Z CAM E2-M4 camera capture system Faceware Mark IV mocap helmets for facial performance capture Industry-grade workstation, built to spec: see our standard build Remote-first for the first 3–6 months, transitioning to hybrid on-site thereafter Work Arrangement We'll start fully remote for a 3–6 month grace period while you ramp up and get embedded with the team, then transition to a hybrid on-site schedule. Makeshift Software Inc is the developer and publisher of Hexborn.

Keywords are an international technical service provider to the global Video Game Industry with offices in Montreal, Dublin, London, Paris, Milan, New Delhi, Tokyo, Shanghai, Singapore, Pune, Rome, Barcelona, Brazil, Los Angeles, and Seattle. Working on a worldwide basis, we provide a range of linguistic, testing, and quality control services to Video Game Developers and Publishers alike. Job Summary Reporting to the Lead Sound Engineer / Audio Tech Lead, the Sound Engineer will collaborate with the global team of Sound Engineers performing technical audio tasks like postproduction, effects, mastering, leveling and mixing, among others. Sound engineers will be designated as Audio Project Leads (APL) for certain project batches, thus overseeing the project’s audio technical management and coordinating with their colleagues and other stakeholders like Project Managers, Audio Asset Managers, Audio QA, Recording Studios, etc. Key Responsibilities and Activities Sound Engineer Tasks Prepare recording sessions following best practices or specific project/client/recording studio needs. Follow technical specifications in the tasks they perform. • Perform audio postproduction on recorded assets. Work on other audio tasks like mixing, sound effect creation, audio batch analysis and processing, etc. Keep constant communication with their manager, sharing any relevant information about their workload, risks and opportunities they anticipate. Coordinate with fellow colleagues doing postproduction work. Build productive working relationships with all other Globalize teams, like Project Managers, Audio Asset Managers, Audio QA, Recording Studios, etc. Audio Project Lead (APL) Tasks Oversee the technical management of specific audio projects or batches. Work alongside Project Managers, Audio QA, Audio Asset Managers, or Recording Studios to ensure the project’s timelines, technical specs and quality demands are met. Coordinate the work of other Sound Engineers on these projects. Support their manager on onboarding, training and mentoring other Sound Engineers. Assist Recording Studio teams in tasks like recordings, session preparation, audio deliveries and studio upkeep. Support their manager in promoting a culture of collaboration and mutual support within the Globalize team, with other Service Lines and Shared Services teams. Any other audio tasks at their manager’s request. Requirements Technical Skills Good verbal and written communication skills (English and other language). Ability to communicate clearly and in a concise manner with all the stakeholders, including the members of their team and other teams in Globalize. Good knowledge of the Audio Localization workflows, processes and tools. Good knowledge of digital audio workstations and innovations in the sound engineering field. Basic knowledge of video games market (publishers, developers, platforms, titles, etc.). Experience in audio recording and postproduction. Experience working in the videogames industry is highly preferred. Behavioural skills Demonstrable evidence of successful collaborative teamwork. Ability to use good judgment to prioritize tasks. Able to manage sensitive and confidential information. Able to work under pressure and meet deadlines in a fast paced, complex environment. *Kindly submit your CV in English. Due to the high volume of applications, only shortlisted candidates will be contacted. Benefits Keywords Studios is dedicated to following a well-established Equal Opportunities Policy. We endeavour to create a workplace which provides equal opportunities for all employees and potential employees. At Keywords Studios, we value and encourage diversity in all its forms. We foster an inclusive environment and give special priority to the inclusion of people with disabilities, as we believe that diversity enriches and strengthens us as a team. We’re looking for someone to take ownership of sound production in our studio. We create radio and TV commercials, digital content, animation and films. Sound is an integral part of every stage of our production process – from recording and sound design to final mixing and broadcast-ready delivery. If you feel just as comfortable behind the mixing desk as you do working with people, enjoy creative challenges and know how to deliver high-quality sound even under tight deadlines, we’d love to hear from you! WHAT WILL YOU BE DOING? – Recording, editing and mixing audio, as well as preparing final audio deliverables for radio, television, online platforms and cinema – Creating sound design for radio and TV commercials, animation and films – Running recording sessions – from welcoming clients and directors to the studio to working with actors, voice-over artists and vocalists – Delivering projects based on briefs and guidelines provided by clients, directors and creative teams – Independently planning your workload, setting priorities and ensuring tasks are completed on time – Supporting the estimation and pricing of sound production projects based on their scope and production requirements WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR – Experience in sound production for commercials, animation or film, backed by a portfolio – Proficiency in Pro Tools on macOS and confidence working with audio plugins – Knowledge of broadcast loudness standards and technical delivery specifications for broadcasters and online platforms – The ability to lead recording sessions and work effectively with actors, voice-over artists and vocalists – Confidence communicating with clients, directors and creative teams – Openness to feedback and the ability to incorporate it into the creative process – Creativity, a good ear and attention to detail – Excellent organisational skills, punctuality and patience – even when deadlines are tight and projects are demanding – Fluency in English Nice to have – Experience estimating and pricing sound production projects – An interest in new tools, technologies and trends in audio production, along with a desire to keep developing your craft How to apply Send us your CV and portfolio so we can get to know your experience and approach to sound. For each project, briefly describe your contribution.
