Audio Composer About Fun Waffle At Fun Waffle Game Studios, we are passionate about crafting immersive, story-driven gaming experiences. Our unannounced Narrative Adventure project draws inspiration from the golden era of point-and-click adventure games, combining intricate storytelling with modern aesthetics. We are seeking a talented Audio Composer to create a captivating audio landscape that enhances our game's emotional and narrative depth. The Position As an Audio Composer, you will design and implement a rich and immersive soundscape that includes original music, sound effects, and ambient audio. Collaborating closely with the Narrative Director and Design Team, you’ll ensure the audio elements support gameplay mechanics, enhance storytelling, and elevate the player’s emotional experience. Key Responsibilities Compose and produce original music that aligns with the game’s tone, narrative, and setting. Design and implement sound effects that enhance gameplay, character actions, and environmental interactions. Create ambient audio to bring game environments to life and deepen immersion. Collaborate with the Design and Narrative teams to align audio with story beats, gameplay pacing, and emotional arcs. Integrate audio assets into Unreal Engine, ensuring proper implementation and optimization. Mix and master audio tracks for consistent quality and performance. Develop and maintain an audio style guide to ensure consistency across all sound elements. Troubleshoot and refine audio assets based on team feedback and playtesting. Qualifications Proven experience as an Audio Composer in the gaming industry, with a strong portfolio showcasing music and sound design. Proficiency in audio production tools such as Pro Tools, Logic Pro, Reaper, or equivalent. Familiarity with implementing audio in Unreal Engine, including the use of audio cues and Blueprints. Strong understanding of adaptive and interactive audio systems in games. Ability to compose in various musical styles, with a focus on creating mood and atmosphere. Excellent communication skills and ability to collaborate across disciplines. Strong attention to detail and a passion for storytelling through audio. Bonus Skills Experience with foley recording and implementation. Knowledge of spatial audio techniques and 3D soundscapes. Familiarity with dynamic music systems and middleware such as Wwise or FMOD. Experience composing for narrative or adventure games. Equity-Based Project Opportunity This role is part of an equity-based project. You’ll earn a percentage of the profits when the game ships within a 12-month rolling calendar. https://gamejobs.co/Senior-Audio-Design-.title: Senior Audio Design QA Analyst
https://gamejobs.co/Senior-Audio-Design-.description: To create revolutionary, story-driven RPGs which go straight to the hearts of gamers — this is our mission. Want to dive deeper into our company’s culture? Explore our social media and check out our YouTube channel and Beyond the Game Blog where we share behind-the-scenes insights and stories direct from our team members! CD PROJEKT RED is looking for a Senior Audio Design QA Analyst to take ownership of quality across key areas of our game audio experience. In this role, you will work closely with Sound Design, Music and other Audio teams throughout development, helping define the quality bar, identify risks and ensure that audio supports gameplay, storytelling and the intended creative experience. You will combine a highly developed critical ear with strong QA expertise and a practical understanding of interactive audio implementation. As a Senior, you will go beyond identifying individual issues. You will drive complex audio quality topics to completion, establish effective testing approaches, provide informed quality recommendations, improve our QA practices and support the development of other team members. Responsibilities Take end-to-end responsibility for complex audio features, from early development through final release. Define test plans, coverage, and quality benchmarks across all audio domains (SFX, music, dialogue, ambience, systems, mix). Assess audio for both technical functionality and creative goals, prioritizing gameplay readability, immersion, and emotional impact. Diagnose complex issues across assets, logic, and systems using Wwise, Unreal Engine, and Blueprints. Partner with sound/music designers and programmers to communicate risks, offer feedback, and drive solutions. Lead testing efforts for major audio features, establishing priorities, validation approaches, and dedicated test environments. Provide data-driven quality recommendations and highlight critical blockers requiring pre-release fixes. Identify inefficiencies in audio QA processes and drive improvements to testing methodologies and tools. Elevate bug reporting quality, maintain documentation, and mentor junior team members on audio testing practices. Research advances in interactive audio and modern QA practices to continually refine evaluation methods. 5+ years of professional experience in game QA, audio, or a relevant development discipline, with a track record of owning quality for complex systems throughout the production cycle. Critical listening skills to evaluate audio beyond basic functionality, ensuring consistency, balance, creative intent, and alignment with the player experience. Deep understanding of interactive game audio systems, including sound effects, ambience, music, and dialogue, and how they interact during gameplay. Proficiency in Wwise (or comparable middleware) and modern game engines like Unreal Engine, with the ability to investigate implementation-related audio issues. Experience creating and maintaining robust test strategies, test plans, and structured coverage for complex features. Ability to assess quality risks and player impact, prioritize issues effectively, and communicate clear recommendations. Ability to provide detailed, constructive, and actionable feedback to both creative and technical specialists. Experience improving QA workflows, testing approaches, and mentoring less experienced team members. Strong spoken and written English. Nice to have Professional background in Sound Design, Technical Sound Design, or Audio Implementation, with experience shipping at least one PC or console title. Strong command of audio production fundamentals, including mixing, dynamics, and signal flow. Experience with standard DAWs like Reaper or Pro Tools. Expertise in 3D/spatial audio systems and testing complex interactive audio (music, dialogue, ambience). Experience with accessibility and gameplay readability considerations, as well as evaluating audio across diverse hardware and playback environments. Proven ability to coordinate testing with external QA teams and build custom test maps or debug tools for audio validation. Working mode Office-First: working primarily from the Warsaw studio in a full time or hybrid mode. Relocation Support Relocation package – flight ticket, company apartment for your first month, relocating your pet, shipping your belongings — it’s all covered. Relocation assistance — processing your legalization operations for you, assistance with finding residence, tax settlements — all you need to feel right at home is taken care of. Polish lessons for foreign employees — and for your spouse or partner, too. Health & Well-Being Private medical healthcare — a selection of medical plans with dental care and unlimited rehabilitation to choose from, which are also accessible for your partner and relatives. Life insurance — comprehensive pension and insurance plans to protect you and your loved ones. Annual screenings for cancer prevention covered by the company. Psychological and psychiatrist care — free mental health support and various well-being initiatives. Sports card — gain access to a wide number of sporting and fitness facilities across the city. Menstrual leave — employees who menstruate can take one extra day off when experiencing period pain. RED Parents Network — support for working parents, including childcare benefits, and family-friendly events. RED Summer Camp for Kids — a fun summer program for children aged 5–12, majoritively paid by the company. Perks & Professional Growth A welcome pack filled with goodies — to help you feel right at home once you join the team. Trainings, lectures, and courses — workshops and trainings for each employee, knowledge-sharing initiatives, online tutorials, and e-learning classes are all available. There’s always something to learn! REDs have access to the cafeteria platform through which they can receive subscription benefits, additional medical packages or vouchers and codes to shops, cinemas, and public transport reimbursement. Gifts for newborn rebels and regular chances to nab some cool swag! Social Activities & Life in the Office Dog-friendly office — dog owner? Bring your pooch with you and look after them while working! There’s always a furry friend or two to meet at the studio. Social events — we host regular gatherings at the studio where we can all unwind, play games, and just have some fun together. Healthy selections — ​​canteens. Truly international working environment — a chance to meet and work with a diverse selection of people from all around the world. Sustainability is an ongoing commitment for us, and our campus has  electric car charging points, green zones, and much more. Read all about it on our Beyond the Game Blog. A designated space for your bicycle, as well as bicycle repair equipment and showers available whenever you need them. An onsite, well-equipped gym with a climbing wall, daily Gym Assistant support, and yoga and boxing classes. No dress-code — we like to keep it casual. Estimated pay range for this position: 14 200 - 24 400 PLN gross monthly. Final offers are dependent on job-related factors like experience and qualifications. Working closely with Audio Code, Sound Design, Music and QA teams, you will be responsible for validating complex audio systems, investigating difficult technical problems and building effective testing solutions. You will work across C++, Unreal Engine and Wwise, using debugging and profiling tools to understand not only when something fails, but why. As a Senior, you will own complex technical quality topics end-to-end, make risk-based recommendations, develop testing and automation solutions, improve pipelines and practices, and help other QA team members grow their technical capabilities. Responsibilities Oversee the stability, performance, and quality of shared audio systems throughout the entire development lifecycle. Create comprehensive test strategies and coverage plans to identify technical risks early and define effective validation approaches. Conduct deep-dive investigations and root-cause analysis on complex audio issues using C++, Unreal Engine, and Wwise. Monitor and validate audio system performance metrics, including CPU usage, memory, streaming, and runtime behavior. Design and maintain automated testing solutions, functional test environments, and debugging tools to increase investigation efficiency. Work closely with Audio Code and Design teams to evaluate technical solutions and provide data-driven quality recommendations. Drive improvements to testing pipelines, workflows, and QA practices by researching and integrating new testing technologies. Manage technical QA efforts across in-house and external teams to ensure consistent coverage for complex audio features. Elevate team capabilities through clear technical documentation, knowledge sharing, workshops, and mentoring. 5+ years of professional experience in technical QA, software testing, or game development with a focus on complex technical systems. Proven track record of owning quality, stability, and performance for technical features throughout the development cycle. Strong practical knowledge of Unreal Engine and C++, with the ability to read, investigate, and debug production code. Proficiency with audio middleware like Wwise, including technical debugging and performance profiling. Expertise in using diagnostic and profiling tools such as Unreal Insights, PIX, or Razor to analyze performance data, logs, and traces. Experience designing and implementing automated or programmatic testing solutions, pipelines, and internal tools. Demonstrated ability to perform root-cause analysis across complex systems to identify and resolve technical issues. Skill in designing comprehensive test strategies and coverage plans for technically complex features. Ability to assess technical quality risks and data-driven insights to make actionable recommendations. Nice to have Professional experience in game audio technology, technical audio, or Audio QA with a shipped PC or console title. Hands-on programming experience, including implementing fixes, tooling, or production features. Expertise in creating test frameworks, internal QA tools, and custom testing infrastructure. Experience with automated testing integrated into CI or development pipelines. Strong understanding of audio programming concepts (DSP, mixing, streaming, voice management) and engine-level performance optimization. Advanced Wwise skills, including integration, optimization, and complex profiling. Experience creating debug levels, instrumentation, or visualization tools for complex systems. Working mode Office-First: working primarily from the Warsaw studio in a full time or hybrid mode. Polish lessons for foreign employees — and for your spouse or partner, too. Life insurance — comprehensive pension and insurance plans to protect you and your loved ones. Annual screenings for cancer prevention covered by the company. https://gamejobs.co/Sound-Designer-at-Tr.description: Who are we? Tripledot Studios is one of the largest independent mobile games companies in the world. We are a multi-award-winning organisation, with a global 2,500+ strong team across 12 studios. Our expanded portfolio includes some of the biggest titles in mobile gaming, collectively reaching top chart positions around the world and engaging over 25 million daily active users. Tripledot’s guiding principle is that when people love what they do, what they do will be loved by others. We’re building a company we’re proud of. One filled with driven, incredibly smart and detail-orientated people, who LOVE making games. Our ambition is to be the most successful games company in the world, and we’re just getting started. The role is working within our studio: Tripledot Games About Tripledot Games Tripledot Games is a leading developer and publisher of casual and puzzle games, with a strong presence in London, Warsaw, and Barcelona. The studio is responsible for multiple top 10 titles, including Woodoku, Woodoku Blast, Solitaire, and TripleTile. Our best-in-class data-driven approach spans the entire lifecycle from publishing to machine learning puzzle levels, helping us make fast, smart decisions at every stage of development. We are also one of the largest IAA operators worldwide. Tripledot Games is a diverse and collaborative studio, home to people from over 36 nationalities. We take pride in our craftsmanship, strong focus on outcomes, and continuous improvement, building high-quality, scalable games that players around the world love. Role Overview As a Sound Designer at Tripledot Studios, you'll be responsible for creating, editing, and implementing audio components for our portfolio of games. You will collaborate with our creative teams to craft an immersive audio experience that compliments the game's visuals and gameplay. Key Responsibilities: Create original and engaging sound design for games, including gameplay actions, user interface interactions, animations, rewards, transitions, and other in-game moments. Take ownership of sound design across multiple features and projects, from initial concept through final delivery. Edit, mix, and master audio to produce polished, balanced results across different devices. Collaborate closely with game designers, artists, developers, producers, and other members of the audio team. Communicate effectively with international colleagues, particularly teams based in London, Barcelona, and Australia. Interpret creative briefs, propose suitable audio direction, and respond constructively to feedback. Review audio within the game, identify areas for improvement, and iterate until the sound supports the intended player experience. Organize audio assets and project files clearly, following consistent naming and delivery practices. Manage priorities and deliver high-quality work within agreed timelines. Contribute positively to team discussions and support a collaborative working environment. Requirements : Strong sound design, sound editing, and mixing skills. A good understanding of audio processing, including equalization, compression, dynamics, spatial effects, and level balancing. Proficiency with at least one professional digital audio workstation. Ability to create a complete audio experience using sound effects, audio libraries, voice-over, music, recording, layering, and creative processing. A strong ear for detail, timing, tonal balance, and how sound supports visual feedback and the player experience. Openness to learning and adopting new audio tools, technologies, and workflows. Ability to interpret a creative brief and independently develop an appropriate audio direction. Professional working proficiency in written and spoken English. Strong communication and collaboration skills, including confidence working with colleagues across different locations and time zones. Good organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple tasks or projects. A reliable and constructive approach to teamwork and feedback. Nice to Have Music composition and production skills, as it may occasionally be required. Previous experience creating audio for games, particularly mobile or casual games. An understanding of mobile audio limitations, file optimization, loudness, and playback consistency across devices. Experience with collaborative asset-management workflows. Working at Tripledot Hybrid Working 20 days of remote working: Work from anywhere in the world, or use the time to cover mandatory office days to WFH, 20 days of the year. Regular company events and rewards: Join in regular events and rewards that celebrate cultural events, our achievements, and our team spirit. Breakfast & Lunch: Relish daily breakfast and lunch provided in the office to keep you fueled and focused. https://gamejobs.co/Senior-Audio-Program.description: Ubisoft is a global leader in gaming with teams across the world creating original and memorable gaming experiences, from Assassin’s Creed, Rainbow Six to Just Dance and more. We believe diverse perspectives help both players and teams thrive. If you’re passionate about innovation and pushing entertainment boundaries, join our journey and help create the unknown! We’re a small, empowered team building an ambitious multiplayer experience, developed in Unreal Engine. We’re looking for hands‑on developers with a strong execution mindset, ownership, and pride in building something real—together. What you’ll do Gather and understand the project's audio vision and requirements, and identify the necessary development needs. Analyze existing audio engine features and determine whether they align with the project's creative and technical goals. Propose improvements to the audio pipeline by identifying project-specific needs and designing and implementing new systems when required. Manage and challenge memory and CPU resource budgets for audio systems. Work closely with the Audio Design team to help achieve design objectives while staying within the allocated performance budget. Write clear, structured, and maintainable code while considering performance, scalability, and compatibility requirements. Validate and test newly developed systems to ensure they meet project objectives and integrate seamlessly with existing codebases. Investigate, diagnose, and resolve audio-related bugs reported by other disciplines and the Quality Assurance (QA) team. Document work thoroughly to facilitate knowledge sharing and help end users (other development teams) understand and effectively use new audio systems and features. Perform any other related duties as required. What You Bring Minimum of 5 years of experience in audio programming or other relevant experience. Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or an equivalent discipline. Strong analytical and critical-thinking skills. Excellent problem-solving abilities. Self-sufficient, resourceful, and able to work independently. Strong interpersonal and communication skills. Flexibility in planning and organizing work. Ability to collaborate effectively within a team environment. Adaptability to changing priorities and project requirements. Results-driven mindset with a focus on delivering quality outcomes. Knowledge of audio terminology, compression formats, and audio middleware solutions. Understanding of the various disciplines involved in game production and development.

https://www.workwithindies.com/careers/d.description: Hi! I'm Jamie. I am gathering applications for a sound effects creator on our indie game at Dreamaloid Studios. The sound effects we need are for retro pixel style minigames, and for the game's normal world. It's for an RPG with a lot of minigames. The game is set to release on PC and possibly Android in the future. Important Details My schedule for meeting is typically 13:30-17:30, 04:05-06:30UTC varying days of the week. Communication is one of the most important points we care about. If we have difficulty reaching you and communicating, it won't work. You need to be communicative. Everyone at our studio is very passionate about this project, so we will select only quality. We are very warm and welcoming, and are having fun making this game. How to Apply To apply, you must attach all 3 of the following in the email as a file, if any are missing your application will be ignored. CV document Sample of your sound effects work. A document stating the following: your schedule with your time zone and your discord username. You may send any extra work samples, website, or information if you'd like. However the above 3 files will be prioritized in screening. Thank you, looking forward to your application!
